scope: Development benchmark. The preceding candidate is the local paired reference; official scoring uses the platform baseline.

official_public_checks.note: Local diagnostic only; no performance/Agent scores or platform callbacks.

outside_range_dataset: Continuous FP32. Every query replaces coordinate query_index % 128 with 4.125 or -4.25.

measurement.scope: Local paired development run using the specified reference image.
measurement.measurement: Two CPUs, 64 MiB, no swap, disconnected containers with fresh Docker volumes. io.stat is for the volume backing device shared with image storage. memory.peak includes one final probe process. No host cache reset.
